capabilities: Sync assigned GitHub issues into mapped notes
Add Tasks-compatible IDs and creation dates
Notify about new assignments in notice and status bar
Append a configurable source tag on sync
extras: Built-in GitHub App supports the Committed Sins account only; other accounts must configure a Device Flow-enabled GitHub App with Issues: read-only. Tokens are kept in Obsidian SecretStorage, while imported titles and links are stored in the vault. Minimum Obsidian 1.11.4, searchable settings on 1.13+, tested on Windows with Obsidian 1.15.1 (0.1.8). Mobile, live token renewal and private README access are unverified. Recurring tasks and automatic deletion are unsuitable for imported issues; GitHub controls titles and open/closed status. Releases ship SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
problem: Issues assigned to you on GitHub live outside the vault, so they cannot be tracked next to existing notes and their Tasks metadata.

relations.evidence: Respect Obsidian Tasks is enabled by default
using the saved Tasks emoji or Dataview format and global filter

summary: GitHub integration that syncs issues assigned to you into existing notes as native Markdown tasks, with assignment notices and README previews.
